name: RTK Bridge
description: Detects RTK (Rust Token Killer) on PATH and toasts a one-shot setup hint. Pair with the `aiShellPrefix = 'rtk '` preference in Settings → Agents to route TEDI's built-in AI shell tools through RTK for 60–90% token savings. Requires RTK installed separately by the user.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
